name: Test Python Template for Class
summary: Class example of the brainlife.io Python App template (marked for deletion): reslices a T1-weighted image to a chosen voxel size with DIPY.
description: Test App registered for a class; the registry text says it should be deleted. main.py reslices the T1 with dipy.align.reslice and saves out_dir/t1.nii.gz. Do not use: the default outres (1,1,1) cannot be parsed by main.py, which splits on spaces, and the file is written to out_dir rather than the registered output out_res.

inputs.description: This is a simple T1w NIFTI-1 file that the app needs to load to resample

outputs.description: THis is a resampled T1w File compatible with a anat/t1w datatype

parameters.description: Output voxel size in mm. main.py expects three space-separated integers (e.g. '1 1 1'); the registered default '1,1,1' fails to parse.

citations.text: Hayashi S, Caron BA, et al., Pestilli F. brainlife.io: A decentralized and open source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. arXiv (2023).
